item.title: Implement SPEC.md rate limiter in ratelimit.py
item.brief: Implement the TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter classes in ratelimit.py exactly as specified in SPEC.md. Preserve dependency-free standard-library-only behavior. Cover all specified validation/error cases and edge cases, including fractional refill, backwards clock handling without rewinding the latest observed time, non-consuming wait_time, keyed independence, LRU eviction where both try_acquire and wait_time count as use, and full restart after eviction. Inspect existing tests and add targeted tests for spec cases they do not cover, then run the test suite. Commit the completed work on the local branch. Acceptance: both classes meet SPEC.md; all existing and added tests pass; implementation uses only the standard library; a commit is created.
